ns2:course.label: Grp Instr Pno for Mus Maj IV
ns2:course.description: (MUSIC 163) Moderately advanced group instruction in piano for music majors whose principal performing medium is voice, or an orchestral or band instrument. Continuation of MUS 174: emphasis on solos, ensemble compositions, technical development, and more advanced work in sight reading, harmonization, improvisation, transposition, and aural skills. Prerequisite: MUS 201, MUS 207; MUS 174 or equivalent.
